overview_description.description:
Pylon is the only agentic support platform, purpose-built for B2B companies. For leaders scaling AI-native support teams, Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work – investigating, resolving, and acting on every signal across every channel that matters.

Unlike platforms built before the AI era, Pylon enriches every interaction with deep account-level context, automates the low impact customer work, and surfaces answers before your team even has to ask. The result: faster responses, happier customers, and a system that continuously improves itself.

product.name: Unified Inbox
product.description: A centralized platform to manage support tickets from multiple communication channels including Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, email, and chat.

product.name: AI Agents for B2B Support
product.description: AI-powered agents that automate ticket pre-work like routing, clarifying questions, and fetching customer context for B2B support workflows.

product.name: Knowledge Base
product.description: A system to create, manage, and version support articles and collections for customer self-service and internal use.

product.name: Customer Portal
product.description: A platform for customers to access support resources, submit tickets, and interact with support teams through multiple channels.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: Tools to automate business processes in support using triggers, macros, and runbooks to streamline responses and actions.

product.name: AI Article Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that drafts support articles automatically based on resolved issues to assist knowledge base creation.
